generated_for: REST (APIClient + JWT) and MCP (ToolRegistry.dispatch_request + reqlo_* API key) driven against the real test DB, with two synthetic extended attributes injected into every bootstrapped definition: 'ws0_probe' (type text, length rule) and 'contract_probe_flag' (type boolean, #941).

checks.CREATE: the bare create for the item type failed (attribute '*')
checks.W: a create carrying the attribute was rejected
checks.R: the read-back did not return the attribute key
checks.V: REST and MCP disagreed on accepting an out-of-rule probe value
checks.UPDATE: the create -> update -> read path did not round-trip the new value
checks.ROUNDTRIP: the read-back value differed from the written value (or was not stable across reads)
checks.DISCOVERY: the REST attribute-schema endpoint / MCP attribute_definition.get omitted the item type or an attribute
checks.SEARCH: artifact.search did not surface the backing Artifact's extended attributes
checks.TREE: artifact.get_tree did not surface a node's extended attributes

semantics: Ratchet, not a wish-list: the test is green while ACTUAL violations are a SUBSET of the violations list and ACTUAL limitations are a SUBSET of the limitations list; a NEW entry of either kind fails, and (strict shrink) an entry that no longer reproduces also fails. Remove closed entries when a WS lands. WS1 #935 closed all of its limitations (status read-back on ArchitectureElement/Icd, artifact.search, artifact.get_tree, attribute_definition.update(sections)); only the WS0 #941 evidence gaps remain. violations carry ws_issue; limitations carry the concrete issue (WS0 #941) and a reason that names exactly why the cell cannot be exercised.
